blurb: At Huron Shores Golf Club, you get the breathtaking scenery, mature hardwoods, and cool lake breezes of a Northern Michigan getaway right here in the Thumb. Established in 1925, our historic 18-hole regulation course is conveniently located just 3 miles north of Port Sanilac.
